idea-plugin.name: Intel HEX & S-record Image Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Recomputes every checksum in a .hex or .srec image and maps every address it writes, before the image reaches the programmer.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Intel HEX & S-record Image Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 17 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/hex-image-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/hex-image-audit

action.text: Intel HEX & S-record Image Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Intel HEX & S-record Image Audit on the file in the editor
